title: All One-Word Domains: a sample of 1,000 names with status and prices
description:
1,000 real one-word domain names, each with its status, the price to register or buy it and the price to renew it for a year (in USD, when known), two coarse bands, the word's length, a registrar and, on a few rows, the registration and expiry dates. A one-word domain name is one word followed by an ending, as in get.plumbing. Each word exists once on each ending, so every row is a name nobody can make a second time.

The files are all.csv and all.json. The GitHub repository refreshes them every night, and this record holds them as they were on the day of its release, so a result built on it can be reproduced and cited. The rows are a sample, in the list's own neutral order, of a list of about 16.6 million names that you can search at https://unique.domains/domains.

The Unique.domains API serves the same catalog at GET https://api.unique.domains/v1/domains. It needs no key and returns 20 names a page, within 60 calls an hour and 100 a day from one address. Documentation: https://unique.domains/api.
